historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 7.0% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr (2.2%) and EPS 5yr (0.6%) because FY2020 was the prior cycle peak (HDT industry 1.6m units) and FY2022 the trough (revenue RMB59bn); the 3yr figures off the FY2022 trough (revenue +22.7%, EPS +57.7%) are equally unrepresentative. Equity CAGR is the only series that is not a cycle artefact and is the selected anchor; the scenario paths are built on the cycle, not on any CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - finance income, RMB m): FY2018 2,739; FY2019 7,763; FY2020 18,359; FY2021 -5,889; FY2022 9,281; FY2023 8,495; FY2024 7,457; FY2025 5,885. Average FY2022-FY2025 RMB7,780m. The owner-FCF CAGRs (-14.1% 3yr, -20.3% 5yr) sit below the reported-FCF CAGRs (-11.2%, -18.6%) because finance income has grown from RMB58m (FY2020) to RMB608m (FY2025) as the cash pile built: an increasing share of reported FCF is interest on cash, not truck profits. SBC is immaterial (0.09% of revenue) so it contributes nothing to the gap.

scenario_narratives.base: Sinotruk is at a cycle high: China HDT industry volume +27% in 2025 and +23% in H1 2026 on the China IV-and-below scrappage subsidy, and exports (~45% of China's HDT exports, 200-220k units guided for 2026) up 57% in H1. Base takes FY2026 revenue +22% (below the H1 run-rate, above the RMB125.5bn third-party target), one more modest year, then a 2028-29 downturn of roughly -10% cumulative as the subsidy cycle and the export surge normalise, before a recovery to a 2.5% terminal rate. EBITDA margin absorbs H1 FY2026's FX losses (8.6%), recovers to 9.0%, dips to 8.0-8.2% in the downturn and settles at the six-year average of 9.0%. Cash tax drifts from 15% to 17%, capex rises from a decade-low 1% of revenue to 1.8% for NEV platforms and overseas KD plants, and growth consumes working capital (-8% of each year's revenue change) as the captive finance book and export receivables expand. Terminal value capped at 13x owner FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: Exports run at or above the raised 200-220k guidance and keep compounding through the 'brand going overseas' localisation push; domestic demand plateaus after the subsidy rather than falling, helped by 15th Five-Year Plan infrastructure projects; FX losses reverse; NEV HDT leadership (industry-leading share in H1 FY2026) and the SITRAK premium mix lift EBITDA margin back to the FY2020 10%+ level and hold it there. Cash tax stays at 15%, working capital drag is lighter (-5%), terminal cap 15x on 3.0% growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: The cycle turns in 2027: domestic scrappage subsidies taper, infrastructure support disappoints and export growth normalises against a protectionist backdrop, producing a FY2021-22-style two-year revenue drawdown (-10%, -15%). Margins trough at 6.5% (below the FY2022 7.4%) on competitive discounting at home and in NEV, FX losses on emerging-market receivables persist, and the MAN/TRATON technology relationship loosens after the stake sale. HNTE status and the R&D super-deduction erode (cash tax to 20%), NEV capex runs at 2% of revenue, and working capital absorbs 15% of each revenue increase as the auto-finance book grows and the 60-day SME payment rule pressures 242-day payables. Terminal cap 11x on 2.0% growth.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A cyclical OEM at a cycle high should be valued on mid-cycle flows with the cycle inside the base path, not on the FY2026 run-rate. Sinotruk's value is roughly one-third balance sheet (net cash plus associates less NCI, ~RMB8/share) and two-thirds a mid-cycle owner FCF stream of ~RMB8-9bn capped at 13x. The house basis expenses SBC (immaterial here) and strips finance income against the cash it is earned on. The current price implies the market is paying roughly the bear case, i.e. it is pricing a 2027 downturn plus a structural SOE/cyclical discount. No-re-rate memo: if the terminal is instead capped at ~7x EBITDA (the top half of the stock's own 3-9x range over the last cycle), the base value is ~RMB4/share (~HK$4.5) lower; the gap is the price of the re-rating thesis.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle timing: base assumes the downturn starts in 2028; if it starts in 2027 at bear depth, value converges on the bear case

Working-capital structure: RMB80.6bn trade and bills payables (242 days) fund RMB75bn of receivables, financing receivables and inventory; a forced shortening of payment terms would consume a large share of the RMB30bn cash pile that the bridge treats as surplus
Captive finance book (RMB23.8bn net financing receivables, <80k borrowers) credit losses in a downturn; impairment allowance RMB716m
Policy dependence: China IV-and-below scrappage subsidy and NEV incentives drove the FY2025-26 domestic recovery
Export concentration in Africa, Middle East, CIS, Latin America: FX losses already cost 1.5pp of HDT segment margin in H1 FY2026; tariffs and counterparty risk
Tax: HNTE 15% rate and R&D super-deduction versus 25% statutory; bear ramps cash tax to 20%
Governance: SOE parent (SDHi/CNHTC) connected transactions, MAN/TRATON stake reduced from ~25% toward ~20%
FX bridge: HKD value moves 1:1 with CNY/HKD; a 5% RMB depreciation is ~5% off the HKD IV

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 23.82-48.40 HKD. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X on the same date.
data_sources.financials: 3808.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, FY2018-FY2025 annual + H1 FY2024-H1 FY2026 interims, RMB millions); FY2025 annual report and H1 FY2026 interim report text in research/3808.HK/Extracted/ for balance-sheet anchors (cash note 16, borrowings, NCI, associates, diluted share count) and the income statement (operating profit, finance income, tax).
data_sources.qualitative: 3808.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-23): guidance (HDT exports 200-220k units FY2026, ~RMB125.5bn revenue and ~8.5% pre-tax margin per third-party reporting), bull/bear axes, risks; H1 FY2026 interim MD&A 'Business strategies and prospects'.

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, consolidated cash flow statement 'Share-based payment' RMB94,435k (3808.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:12046); equity-award taxes nil (restricted award shares are funded by a trustee purchasing shares on-market, no net-share settlement)
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 nil. FY2024 RMB512m was the trustee's on-market purchase of shares for the restricted award share scheme (treasury shares held by trustee, 18.97m shares / 0.69% at 30 June 2026), i.e. the funding of SBC, not a capital return.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted average at 30 June 2026 per H1 FY2026 interim note (3808.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:5719-5728): 2,735,433k ordinary shares in issue ex-treasury + 11,082k deemed-issue effect of the restricted award share scheme = 2,746,515k. Issued share capital is 2,760,993k including ~25.5m treasury shares held by the scheme trustee. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge it twice.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. All per-share values computed in CNY and converted at CNY/HKD 1.1742 (Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22). Direction: HKD = CNY x 1.1742. Cross-check: the company's own interim market-cap disclosure used HK$1 = RMB0.86855 at 30 June 2026 (= 1.1513 CNY->HKD), 2% from today's rate, consistent with RMB appreciation since June. No dual listing of the HK parent exists for a parity tie (000951.SZ is the 51%-owned A-share subsidiary, a different entity).
inputs.cash_note: Cash = cash and cash equivalents RMB18,825.2m + time deposits with original maturity 3-12 months RMB11,165.5m (H1 FY2026 note 16, 3808.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:6279-6284). EXCLUDED: restricted cash RMB4,738.0m (pledged for letters of credit and bank acceptance bills, i.e. it backs operating payables), FVOCI bank acceptance bills RMB12,105.5m (customer settlement instruments, operating receivables), FVPL wealth-management products RMB1,327.7m (their returns sit in 'other income and gains' inside operating profit, so under the matching-asset rule the asset stays out of the bridge). Finance income of RMB607.9m (FY2025) earned on the cash pile is stripped from owner FCF because the pile is added to EV.
inputs.debt_note: Total debt = borrowings RMB4,386.1m current + RMB346.8m non-current = RMB4,732.8m, plus lease liabilities RMB4.8m + RMB7.2m = RMB12.0m (H1 FY2026 balance sheet, 3808.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:4775-4788). All borrowings RMB-denominated, 94.5% fixed rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' own currency (CNY). China 10-year CGB ~1.9% risk-free, China equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.15 for a cyclical commercial-vehicle OEM -> cost of equity ~9.4%; net-cash balance sheet so WACC ~= cost of equity. Rounded to 9.5%, applied identically to all three scenarios: cyclicality, policy dependence and SOE governance are charged ONCE, in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt. Lease liabilities (RMB12.0m, immaterial) are included in total_debt; lease principal (RMB5.2m FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows. Right-of-use depreciation (RMB62m FY2025) is inside the D&A line, which is consistent with treatment A.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows; non-controlling interests deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at book value RMB8,373.2m (30 June 2026). NCI took 8.4% of FY2025 profit (RMB645m of RMB7,664m) and 9.2% in H1 FY2026; 8.4-9.2% of the modelled equity value is RMB8-11bn, bracketing book, so the book deduction is a fair single charge. FY0 NOPAT calibration is against TOTAL profit (RMB7,664m), not attributable.
inputs.associates_treatment: Share of profits of associates (RMB175m FY2025; RMB128m H1 FY2026, mostly the 37.5% stake in SDHi Finance Co acquired for RMB3,485m in 2025 plus parts-trading associates) is below operating profit and therefore OUTSIDE the EBITDA-driven flows; the matching asset, investments in associates at book RMB5,220.4m (30 June 2026), is added in the equity bridge.
inputs.working_capital_note: Manufacturer with a captive finance book: receivables + financing receivables + inventory (RMB75bn) are funded by trade and bills payables (RMB80.6bn, 242 payable days). Growth has absorbed cash in the last three periods (FY2025 OCF fell 24% on +15% revenue; H1 FY2026 OCF +3% on +39% revenue; financing receivables RMB19.5bn -> RMB23.8bn in six months), so wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-8% of the revenue change in base). A revenue decline releases working capital symmetrically, which is what happens to a truck OEM in a downcycle.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials'), with the adaptations in owner-fcf-adaptations.md applied: CNY-built WACC, CNY/HKD fx bridge, lease treatment A, NCI charged once in the bridge, associates matched asset-for-income, interest income stripped against net cash, SBC explicit at ~0.09% of revenue (near-SBC-zero market so the house/street band is almost collapsed). Fresh build: no prior DCF, no memory entry. FY0 = FY2025 (31 Dec) with anchors (cash, debt, NCI, associates, diluted shares) refreshed to the 30 June 2026 interim balance sheet. FY2025 owner FCF = 6,587.1 reported FCF (OCF 7,623.0 - capex 1,035.9) - 94.4 SBC - 607.9 finance income = 5,884.7. Component cross-check for FY2025: 109,541 x 9.14% EBITDA = 10,014; less SBC 94, D&A 1,876 -> EBIT 8,044; cash tax ~15-17% -> NOPAT ~6.7-6.8bn; + D&A - capex 1,036 - working capital ~1.2-1.9bn -> 6.0-6.5bn, which ties to the 5.9bn owner FCF within the FY2025 receivable build. Capex in FY2025 (0.95% of revenue) and H1 FY2026 (0.7%) is at a decade low; base lifts it to 1.8% by maturity, above D&A, for NEV platforms and overseas KD plants. Horizon 10 years because the base path carries a 2028-29 cyclical downturn and the terminal margin is a mid-cycle 9.0% EBITDA, not the FY2026 cycle-high level; the SBC-adjusted FCF history is dominated by working-capital swings (FY2020 peak inflow, FY2021 outflow) so the CAGRs are not a growth anchor. Price is a regular-session close, not volatile.

bear.narrative: Cycle turns in 2027: subsidy taper plus export normalisation produce a FY2021-22-style two-year drawdown; margins trough below the FY2022 7.4%; HNTE/super-deduction erode; working capital absorbs more (export receivables, finance book, payable terms tightening under the 60-day SME payment rule).

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +22%: H1 +39.2% with H2 FY2025 base of RMB58.7bn; management raised HDT export guidance to 200-220k units (+30-43% on 153k) and the Analysis JSON's third-party ~RMB125.5bn (+15%) target is already run-rate-beaten. FY2027 +4% then a 2028-29 downturn (-8%, -2%) as the China IV scrappage subsidy cycle and the export surge normalise, recovering FY2030-31 and fading to 2.5% terminal.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 EBITDA 9.14%; H1 FY2026 8.33% (FX losses on export receivables RMB648m in other expenses). FY2026 8.6%, recovers to 9.0% FY2027 as FX losses normalise, dips to 8.0-8.2% in the 2028-29 downturn (FY2022 trough was 7.4%), settles at the FY2020-FY2025 average of 9.0%.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax 17.2% of PBT in FY2025, 12.5% in H1 FY2026; book ETR 13-14% on HNTE 15% rate plus R&D super-deduction. 15% for four years, drifting to 17% as super-deduction and HNTE renewals carry some risk; statutory is 25%.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap 13x terminal owner FCF (cyclical, 12-15x range); at WACC 9.5%/g 2.5% Gordon is 14.6x so the cap binds. Stock's own EV/EBITDA range over the last cycle is ~3-9x; see valuation_philosophy for the no-re-rate memo.

bull.narrative: Exports at the top of guidance and beyond, domestic plateaus rather than falls, FX losses reverse, NEV HDT leadership lifts mix; margins reach the FY2020 10%+ level and hold.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because the FY2026 base year is a policy-driven cycle high (scrappage subsidy, export surge) in an industry that fell 50% peak-to-trough in FY2020-22, the balance sheet's net cash coexists with 242-day payables that a 60-day SME payment regime could unwind, and SOE governance plus the MAN stake sale add discount risk; bull cut to 20% because it needs exports, domestic demand and margin recovery to all hold simultaneously. Base 50%: the cycle is already modelled inside the base path.
probability_weighted.band_note: House/street band collapsed: SBC is ~0.09% of revenue, so street IV exceeds house IV by only ~HK$0.6/share and the ratio (price - house)/(street - house) is meaningless. Reported as null; Sinotruk is effectively an SBC-zero market name.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
